name: @proma/electron
description: Proma，为专业用户设计的 Agent - Electron App

scripts.dev: bun run scripts/dev-kill.ts --vite && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,green "bun run dev:vite" "bun run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: bun run dev:kill && bun run sync:runtime-deps:dev && bun run rebuild:node-pty && bun run build:native-helpers && bun run prepare:officecli && bun run build:resources && bun run scripts/dev-bundle-readiness.ts --prepare && concurrently -k -n main,agent-runtime,terminal-runtime,preload,app -c yellow,red,blue,magenta,cyan "bun run watch:main" "bun run watch:agent-runtime" "bun run watch:terminal-runtime" "bun run watch:preload" "bun run scripts/dev-bundle-readiness.ts --wait && bunx electronmon ."
